scenes.say: Enphase or Tesla. Which home battery should you get?
One Powerwall three stores thirteen point five kilowatt-hours and delivers eleven point five kilowatts.
One Enphase IQ Battery five P stores five kilowatt-hours. You stack them.
Three five Ps roughly match one Powerwall, usually at a higher total price.
Enphase wins on warranty: fifteen years versus ten, and fits Enphase systems perfectly.
Powerwall three is usually the better value for new solar plus storage, because its inverter is built in.
Choosing a battery? Read the free guide at viva voltia dot com.
